text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: high-severity GPU capacity event detected in eu-west-1. Autoscales failing with provider 429s; queue growth on text-gen-prod. Root TS: 1724123456

incident-bot: alerts: autoscaler.errors=18m, provider.429=240/min, gpu.pool_saturation=95%, active_queue=~14k requests

tess: I'm on it. seeing large tail latencies and 503s for some requests. can folks confirm customer impact?

mike: yep, support seeing elevated 5xx for lower tiers. sample from logs: `error="provider API rate limit" attempt=1`. Autoscaler is hitting provider quota for creating GPUs.

lina: Confirmed. ML infra shows scale_up attempts being throttled: `scaleUp failed: quotaExceeded (429)`. Pools are saturated, attempts queued by controller. KV cache ok but new sessions stuck.

sanjay: Impacted: non-enterprise customers hitting best-effort routes; enterprise SLAs on dedicated pools unaffected. Estimated affected requests: 8-12% of host traffic, tail latency 5-95th: 400ms->4.2s.

kevin: support ramping comms. adding note to status page draft: "temporary throttling, fallback enabled" waiting for ops.

mike: immediate mitigations I can attempt: 1) force fallback routing for best-effort route to smaller quantized model variant; 2) dequeue/delay background batch jobs; 3) create emergency node pool with different provider SKU if API will allow. Thoughts?

lina: Agree. Start with model fallback (fast to flip). I'll prepare the rollout. Also we should enable aggressive queue shedding for non-critical routes.

kevin: I'll post a short status: "We are experiencing degraded generation performance for some customers. Engineers working on fallbacks to restore service."

deploy-bot: Started canary rollout: route `text-gen.best_effort` -> `open-quant-small-v2` on 3% traffic. job id: deploy-9876

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: canary started at 1724123520. monitoring for error drop and latency.

mike: Observing immediate reduction in queued requests for best_effort route: queue length from 14k -> 9.6k in 3m. 429s persisted for autoscaler API though.

lina: I spun up a temporary fallback pool using pre-provisioned reserved GPUs in ap-south-1 we had for demos (different provider account) — tagged `temp-fallback-1724`. Not ideal but buys time.

sanjay: Good. Can we route lower-priority traffic to that pool? We need routing rule that avoids messing with dedicated customers.

mike: Doing `kubectl patch configmap route-table -p '{"data":{"text-gen.best_effort":"pool:temp-fallback-1724,split:60"}}'`

deploy-bot: route patch applied at 1724123602

mike: After routing change queue dropped further to ~3.1k and 5xx counts for best-effort dropped by ~78%. Tail latency still elevated for a small cohort.

kevin: Support update posted. Customers flagged as impacted: some dev accounts and experimental workloads. No enterprise SLAs affected.

lina: Autoscaler still logging provider 429 for new pool creation attempts. We should treat these 429s as transient with exponential backoff in autoscaler. Action item for postmortem.

mike: Created short-term rule to avoid scale-up until autoscaler sees success: `scale_up_backoff=30s` -> `5m` (temporary). Also increased batch size and KV-cache reuse for current workers to reduce token cost.

incident-bot: :hourglass_flowing_sand: Mitigations in place: model fallback canary, temp pool routing, autoscaler backoff increased. Monitoring: queue trending down, provider 429s trending steady.

kevin: Any customers we should proactively contact? I can reach out to top 20 active dev orgs and let them know we're mitigating.

sanjay: Yes please. Also flag support to prioritize customers reporting errors.

mike: Quick diagnostic logs (excerpt):
```
2024-03-15T12:01:22Z autoscaler.go:214 scaleAttempt id=abc123 error="provider API 429: rateLimitExceeded" retries=4
2024-03-15T12:02:11Z poolmgr.go:98 pool=gpu-prod-3 state=full
2024-03-15T12:03:40Z router.go:312 route=text-gen.best_effort queued=9600
```

lina: Post-incident notes we need: 1) autoscaler should detect provider 429 vs other errors and apply jittered backoff + fallback to local capacity; 2) add explicit circuit-breaker for provider quota errors that flips routing to fallback variant automatically; 3) maintain a small hot spare pool per region for emergencies; 4) update runbook to include targeted customer comms.

mike: Agree. Also verify telemetry for queue-breakdown by customer tier — we under-observed low-tier burst patterns.

tess: Oncall signoff: mitigations restored best-effort service to acceptable levels at 1724123700. we will keep monitoring for 2 hours. thanks team.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Please file follow-up postmortem and link action items.

kevin: I'll create the status page postmortem draft and ping stakeholders.

mike: Filed follow-up tasks in board: `INFR-4321` (autoscaler 429 handling), `INFR-4322` (hot spare pools), `INFR-4323` (priority queue shedding), `DOCS-212` (runbook update).

lina: I'll own INFR-4321. Estimated ETA for fix: 2 weeks for robust backoff + circuit-breaker tests.

sanjay: I'll coordinate capacity economics analysis for keeping hot spares.

kevin: Support comms sent, triage updated.

tess: closing handoff. if anything spikes ping pager. :pager:

incident-bot: thread closed for active paging at 1724123778 (mitigated -> monitoring).
